findings.highlight: We had been breathing in that thing's exhaust
findings.evidenceJa: 山林に満ちていた空気はアレの呼吸だ。
findings.governingReading: The living atmosphere filling the forest is the thing's breath, continuing the mountain-as-organ image.
findings.explanation: The flesh mass's breathing becomes mechanical exhaust.

findings.highlight: Ugly muscles ripple under the skin, connecting the body to the flesh hunk.
findings.evidenceJa: その肌に走る醜い筋が、身体と肉塊を繋げている。
findings.governingReading: Ugly streaks or cordlike structures run along Shinji's skin and connect his body to the flesh mass.
findings.explanation: Structures running along Shinji's skin become muscles rippling beneath it. The English adds movement and a more specific anatomical location.

findings.highlight: His body's still breathing, at least.
findings.evidenceJa: 息はある。体だって、まだ
findings.governingReading: He can confirm respiration and begins to say that the body still..., but cannot claim the remaining limbs look human.
findings.explanation: Shirou's interrupted observation of breath and remaining body becomes the body itself breathing.

findings.highlight: it won't break as long as it doesn't return to its original wish-granting form.
findings.evidenceJa: 願望機っていう本来の姿になってなければ壊れてもいない。
findings.governingReading: Rin says there is still time because the Grail has activated, but has neither reached its proper wish-machine form nor yet broken apart.
findings.explanation: The Grail being active but neither complete nor broken becomes a rule that it cannot break until it returns to its original form.

findings.highlight: Normally, I would never suggest this
findings.evidenceJa: 本来なら有無を言わせぬが
findings.governingReading: Gilgamesh ordinarily allows no objection or say in the matter; this time he grants a short reprieve.
findings.explanation: His refusal to allow objections becomes reluctance to make an offer. The surrounding threat and short reprieve remain.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka might actually be able to get across if she says so.
findings.evidenceJa: そう断言できる遠坂なら辿り着ける。
findings.governingReading: He recognizes obvious bravado, yet concludes that precisely Rin, able to make that declaration, can make it across.
findings.explanation: Shirou's trust that a Rin capable of declaring this can reach Shinji becomes only a possibility.
